'''Unni Olsbye''' (born 9 March 1964) is a Norwegian chemist. A professor at the University of Oslo, she has specialized in [[catalyst]]s for the [[petrochemical industry]].

==Career==
Born in [[Hamar]], Olsbye graduated in industrial chemistry from the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] in 1987, and as [[Doctor of Science|dr.scient.]] in [[organic chemistry]] from the [[University of Oslo]] in 1991. She was appointed professor at the Department of Chemistry at the University of Oslo in 2002. Her research focus has been [[Catalysis|catalytic reaction mechanisms]] in the [[petrochemical industry]].<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|title=Unni Olsbye |first=Bjørn |last=Pedersen |authorlink=Bjørn Pedersen |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |editor-last=Bolstad | editor-first=Erik |publisher=Norsk nettleksikon |location=Oslo |url=https://snl.no/Unni_Olsbye |language=no |access-date=16 September 2021}}</ref>

Olsbye was elected member of the [[learned society]], [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]] from 2009, and member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] from 2015.<ref name=snl/>
